project_type: React SPA - Mind Map / Whiteboard Canvas with lightweight Task Management
build_system: Vite with React plugin, Tailwind CSS for styling
verification_instructions: Run npm run build to verify no compile errors. Manual testing for UI changes.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full npm access available. Node v22 with npm available.
contribution_requirements: Keep it simple, lightweight, no complex project-management UI. Card design: 280px wide, left border accent. Task system is secondary layer.
key_patterns: Single-file components (App.jsx ~5275 lines, TaskPanel.jsx). State managed with useState/useRef. Data persisted to localStorage under 'nexus-app-state' as JSON array of projects. Each project contains: workspaces, tasks, taskGroups, cardTaskLinks. Tailwind CSS utility classes throughout. Lucide React for icons.
directory_structure: Flat src/ directory with App.jsx (main logic + canvas), TaskPanel.jsx (task panel component), MiniMap.jsx (minimap overlay), main.jsx (entry), index.css (Tailwind imports). Public assets in public/.
